findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no soap to be available upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and soap was brought to hand sink. Ensure soap is available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed lemonade to be cold holding at 46F. Discussed with PIC, ice bath was created and lemonade was later temped at 41F. Ensure any TCS item being cold held is kept at or below 41F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: On arrival CLO test strips were available but the sanitizer in use uses a Quaternary Ammonia based chemical. Education was conduced and a small amount of Quat test strips were acquired to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed basket in basin of hand washing sink. Basket was removed during inspection.
